## Result report — OCR-2

Implemented the OCR experience end to end: an opt-in `OcrPanel` with every required state, capture and card-detail wiring, explicit title apply/dismiss, persisted OCR metadata, confirmed clearing, and a real-tesseract Playwright journey at desktop, tablet-landscape, and phone viewports.

### Files created

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `src/features/ocr/OcrPanel.tsx` | Idle/loading/reading/done/failed/timed-out/cancelled panel, progress, Cancel, Retry, Run again, Clear OCR, suggestion flow |
| `src/features/ocr/OcrPanel.css` | Token-only panel styles, 44 px actions, focus ring, reduced motion |
| `src/features/ocr/ocrTitle.ts` | Pure first-meaningful-line title helper |
| `tests/ocr/OcrPanel.test.tsx` | 15 component tests for activation, statuses, title rules, persistence, failure, timeout, cancellation, clear, keyboard/focus, targets, contrast, untrusted text |
| `tests/ocr/CardDetailOcr.test.tsx` | Card-detail OCR rendering, confirmed clear persistence, topic exclusion |
| `e2e/ocr.spec.ts` | Real OCR → Apply → save → search → reload → detail journey at 3 viewports |
| `e2e/fixtures/ocr-note.png` | Clear 1400×900 printed-text fixture |

### Files changed

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/features/capture/NoteSourceForm.tsx` | Added pending image prop, OCR panel, title autofill, OCR result included in submitted values |
| `src/features/capture/CapturePage.tsx` | Carried `OcrResult` through the pending draft and import call |
| `src/features/capture/cardImport.ts` | Optional OCR metadata passed into the atomic card creation transaction |
| `src/features/cards/CardDetailPage.tsx` | OCR panel for photo cards, persist/clear/apply-title handlers, stored OCR rendering |
| `src/features/ocr/ocrWorker.ts` | Same-origin absolute worker/core/language URLs and explicit SIMD loader selection |
| `src/data/caseRepository.ts` | Nullable OCR fields in `CardPatch` so Clear OCR removes stored metadata |

### Acceptance criteria

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| OCR runs only after activating Read text | **Pass** | Panel test asserts no worker before activation; E2E asserts `data-ocr-status="idle"` before the click |
| Empty title filled and announced; non-empty unchanged until Apply | **Pass** | Component tests for autofill + live announcement, suggestion Apply/Dismiss, no automatic overwrite |
| Text, confidence, engine version, timestamp persist and survive reload | **Pass** | E2E reads IndexedDB, reloads, re-searches OCR text, then opens detail with stored text/confidence/engine/timestamp |
| Failure and timeout show retry and leave card unchanged; Cancel terminates worker | **Pass** | Component tests assert alerts, Retry, no persistence, unchanged prior result, and worker `terminate()` |
| Playwright completes real OCR and finds text through search | **Pass** | `2× MITOCHONDRIA` fixture search success on desktop 1440×900, tablet 1280×800, phone 390×844 |

### Validation run

- `npm test -- tests/ocr/OcrPanel.test.tsx` — **15 passed**
- `npm run test:e2e -- e2e/ocr.spec.ts` — **3 passed** (desktop, tablet-landscape, phone; real tesseract.js, ~6 s each)
- `npm test` — **796 passed / 61 files**
- `npm run typecheck` — pass
- `npm run lint` — pass
- `npm run format:check` — pass
- `npm run build` — pass (via `test:e2e`)

### Accessibility evidence

- **Focus:** Clear dialog focuses Cancel, Escape closes and restores the Clear trigger, confirm moves focus to the panel heading. Tab order after the panel heading reaches `Run again` then `Clear OCR`.
- **Announcements:** One always-mounted polite live region for fill/suggestion/cancel/clear; failed/timed-out states use an alert and Retry.
- **Targets:** CSS target floor is `var(--target-min)` = 44 px; Playwright bounding boxes ≥44×44 for `Read text`, `Apply`, `Run again`, and `Clear OCR` at all three viewports.
- **Contrast measured:** ink/sunken 13.50, muted/sunken 8.76, heading/sunken 14.25, paper ink/paper 12.99, paper heading/paper 13.49, danger text/surface 8.72, focus ring/sunken 10.46.
- **Motion:** `prefers-reduced-motion` disables panel transitions/animations/scroll behavior.
- **Untrusted text:** OCR text and titles render as text; no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`; no raw palette values in the panel.

### Shared-file handoff notes

- `CardDetailPage.tsx`: preserve the OCR panel placement after the photo/sidebar layout, topic exclusion, and repository-backed persist/clear/apply behavior.
- `CapturePage.tsx` / `NoteSourceForm.tsx`: preserve the `image` prop and `PendingCard.ocr` passthrough so capture OCR survives import retry.
- `cardImport.ts`: optional OCR fields must remain inside the atomic `createCardWithAttachments` call.
- `caseRepository.ts`: `CardPatch` OCR fields accept `null` to clear; do not revert to undefined-only handling.
- `ocrWorker.ts`: keep absolute same-origin URL resolution and the explicit `coreLoaderPath`; using the directory again makes Chromium request the unbundled relaxed-SIMD core and fail.

### Known gaps / limitations

- OCR usefulness on handwriting is still a product observation; the automated fixture is clear printed text.
- This task did not run an axe scan for the OCR panel; QA owns the phase axe matrix.
- OCR in capture reads the pending source file; crop-derived display images are not re-OCR’d at this step.
- Visual styling should still be spot-checked at the human style gate; behavior and accessibility checks pass.

handoff.summary: Implemented OCR-2: an accessible opt-in OcrPanel with all statuses, title autofill/apply/dismiss, persisted OCR metadata, confirmed clear, capture and card-detail wiring, 18 focused component/integration tests, and a real-tesseract Playwright journey passing at desktop, tablet, and phone viewports.
decisions: Empty titles are filled from the first meaningful OCR line and announced; non-empty titles only change through Apply.
Capture OCR metadata is written in the same atomic card transaction as the photo; card detail writes it through updateCard.
Clear OCR uses nullable CardPatch OCR fields so removal is validated and persisted rather than client-only.
The production worker uses absolute same-origin asset URLs and the explicit SIMD LSTM loader because bundled assets do not include the relaxed-SIMD core.
Clear confirmation restores focus to the OCR panel heading when the Clear trigger unmounts with the result.
interfaces: OcrPanel({ image, title, initialResult?, onTitleChange?, onApplyTitle?, onPersist?, onClear?, onResultChange?, ocrOptions?, disabled?, headingLevel?, id? })
